companies.name: Yoti
companies.description: UK-based digital identity and age verification provider offering ID document checks, facial age estimation, and reusable digital ID.
companies.notes: No major public breach identified as of research date; included for completeness given prominent role in UK age-verification market (Online Safety Act compliance).

companies.name: Onfido (an Entrust company)
companies.description: Global identity verification platform providing document verification and biometric facial matching, acquired by Entrust in 2024.
companies.notes: No major public breach identified as of research date; monitored due to scale of ID document processing.

companies.name: Veriff
companies.description: Estonian-founded global identity verification company serving fintech, crypto, mobility and marketplace clients.
companies.notes: No major public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Jumio
companies.description: US-based identity verification and eKYC company using AI-driven document and biometric verification.
companies.notes: No major public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: ID.me
companies.description: US identity verification network used by government agencies (IRS, state unemployment offices) and private sector for identity proofing.
companies.notes: Faced congressional scrutiny over facial recognition and identity-proofing practices, but no confirmed large-scale data breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Sumsub
companies.description: Global KYC/AML and identity verification provider widely used by cryptocurrency exchanges and fintechs.
companies.notes: Disclosed in February 2026 that an intrusion dating back to July 2024 went undetected for roughly 18 months.

companies.name: Trulioo
companies.description: Canadian global identity verification network (GlobalGateway) aggregating data sources for KYC/AML compliance.
companies.notes: No major public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Persona
companies.description: US-based configurable identity verification and KYC platform used by fintech, marketplaces, and crypto companies.
companies.notes: No major public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: AgeChecked
companies.description: UK-based age verification service used for age-restricted online sales and access control.
companies.notes: Included for completeness given role in UK/EU age-verification compliance; no confirmed breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: VerifyMy (VerifyMyAge)
companies.description: UK-based age assurance provider offering age estimation and age verification for online platforms.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: IDnow
companies.description: German identity verification provider offering video identification and automated eKYC across the EU.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: WebID
companies.description: German provider of video identification and eSignature identity verification services.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: IDology (a GBG company)
companies.description: US identity verification and fraud prevention company, part of GBG Group, serving financial services and age-restricted commerce.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: LexisNexis Risk Solutions
companies.description: US risk-management and identity-data aggregator offering KYC/AML and ID verification products (ThreatMetrix, InstantID) and healthcare patient identity management.
companies.notes: No confirmed direct breach of ID-verification data identified as of research date; monitored given scale of identity data holdings.

companies.name: Experian (Identity/KYC products)
companies.description: Global credit bureau offering identity verification and KYC data products alongside credit reporting, including patient identity verification for healthcare.
companies.notes: Experian has had unrelated consumer data-exposure incidents historically; no ID-verification-specific breach confirmed as of research date.

companies.name: AU10TIX
companies.description: Israeli identity-verification technology vendor providing document and biometric verification behind the scenes for major platforms including TikTok, Uber, X, and LinkedIn.
companies.notes: Admin credentials to a logging platform were exposed online for over a year, reported by 404 Media in June 2024.

companies.name: IDMerit
companies.description: California-based AI-powered identity verification provider serving financial services and fintech platforms across 200+ countries.
companies.notes: An unsecured MongoDB database was discovered exposed to the public internet in November 2025, disclosed publicly in February 2026.

companies.name: Fractal ID
companies.description: Web3-focused KYC/identity verification provider used by crypto exchanges and DeFi platforms.
companies.notes: Confirmed unauthorized API access in July 2024 affecting roughly 0.5% of its user base.

companies.name: Signzy
companies.description: India-based (Bengaluru) provider of digital KYC and identity-verification infrastructure for banks and fintechs.
companies.notes: Confirmed infostealer malware incident in late 2024; major banking clients stated their customer data was unaffected.

companies.name: Discord (Age Verification / Trust & Safety vendor)
companies.description: Global chat and community platform; not a dedicated ID-verification vendor, but processes government ID images for age verification via third-party support tooling.
companies.notes: Breach occurred via a compromised third-party customer-support (Zendesk) system, not Discord's core infrastructure.

companies.name: MyGiftCardSupply
companies.description: US online gift-card retailer that collects customer ID documents to comply with anti-money-laundering (KYC) rules.
companies.notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor, but included because it directly stored KYC identity documents that were exposed.

companies.name: Transak (third-party KYC vendor incident)
companies.description: Fiat-to-crypto payment gateway whose third-party KYC vendor was compromised via a phishing attack.
companies.notes: The breach originated at a third-party KYC vendor used by Transak, not at a named public identity-verification brand.

companies.name: Nefos (PuffPal)
companies.description: European platform (PuffPal) providing membership management and age verification for cannabis social clubs and retailers.
companies.notes: Systems hosting age-verification documents for cannabis-club members were left unprotected on the public internet.

companies.name: Tea (Tea Dating Advice app)
companies.description: US women's dating-safety app that required selfie and government-ID verification at signup.
companies.notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because it directly collected and exposed verification selfies and ID photos.

companies.name: Incode
companies.description: US-based identity verification platform offering biometric onboarding, liveness detection, and reusable digital identity for fintech, gig-economy, healthcare, and government clients.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Socure
companies.description: US identity verification and fraud-prevention platform combining data intelligence, document verification, and machine learning risk scoring.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Mitek Systems
companies.description: US provider of mobile document capture and biometric identity verification technology (Mobile Verify) used by banks and fintechs worldwide.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: GBG (GB Group)
companies.description: UK-headquartered global identity data intelligence company providing identity verification, fraud, and location data services; parent of IDology.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: IDEMIA
companies.description: French multinational providing biometric identity solutions, secure ID documents (passports, national IDs), and border control systems for governments worldwide.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Thales Group (Digital Identity & Security)
companies.description: French multinational technology group providing biometric passports, national eID cards, and digital identity infrastructure for governments and enterprises.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Equifax
companies.description: US credit bureau offering identity verification and KYC data products alongside credit reporting services.
companies.notes: Included primarily for its major 2017 breach exposing SSNs and identity data used in KYC/credit-verification contexts, and its ongoing identity-verification product line.

companies.name: TransUnion
companies.description: US credit bureau providing identity verification, fraud analytics, and KYC data solutions alongside credit reporting.
companies.notes: Disclosed a 2025 breach affecting millions of US customer records via a third-party application.

companies.name: Innovatrics
companies.description: Slovakia-based biometric and identity verification technology provider offering facial recognition, fingerprint, and document verification products.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Intellicheck
companies.description: US identity verification company specializing in ID document authentication for retail, financial services, and law enforcement use cases.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Signicat
companies.description: Norwegian digital identity and e-signature platform serving European banks and fintechs with KYC/AML and identity orchestration.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: SecureKey Technologies
companies.description: Identity verification and digital credential network provider, part of Avast/Gen Digital ecosystem, offering privacy-preserving identity verification.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: HyperVerge
companies.description: India-based AI identity verification platform offering document verification, face matching, and liveness detection for fintech and telecom clients globally.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: iDenfy
companies.description: Lithuanian identity verification and KYC/KYB platform supporting over 200 countries and thousands of document types.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: SEON
companies.description: Hungarian digital fraud-intelligence platform building risk profiles from email, phone, IP, and device signals, often paired with KYC workflows.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: ComplyAdvantage
companies.description: UK-based AML-focused compliance platform with proprietary risk-intelligence data covering sanctions, PEPs, and adverse media across 200+ countries.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Identomat
companies.description: AI-powered KYC/AML platform supporting 8,800+ document types across 193+ countries with passive and active liveness detection.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Focal (by Mozn)
companies.description: MENA-region-focused KYC/KYB/AML compliance platform (Focal) built by Saudi AI company Mozn, handling 50,000+ verifications daily.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Togggle
companies.description: Privacy-focused decentralized KYC and reusable digital identity platform.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: ComplyCube
companies.description: UK-based identity verification and AML compliance platform offering document verification, biometric checks, and ongoing monitoring.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Berbix (Socure)
companies.description: US identity verification company acquired by Socure, providing ID document and selfie verification for marketplaces and sharing-economy platforms.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Alloy
companies.description: US identity risk and KYC/KYB decisioning platform used by banks and fintechs to orchestrate multiple verification data sources.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Ondato
companies.description: Lithuanian cloud-based KYC/KYB identity verification platform serving regulated fintechs and SaaS platforms across Europe.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Passbase
companies.description: European identity verification API provider offering document and biometric verification for developers.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: k-ID
companies.description: Age assurance and parental-consent platform used by gaming and social platforms to comply with child-safety regulations worldwide.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: OneID
companies.description: UK Open Banking-based age verification provider, FCA-regulated and DIATF-certified, used for Online Safety Act compliance.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: OneVerify
companies.description: UK age verification platform for gambling, adult content, alcohol, tobacco, and cannabis websites, marketed as storing no user data.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Bouncer Digital
companies.description: Age verification provider using facial recognition and QR-code checks for gaming platforms and vending machines, focused on LATAM markets.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Privately
companies.description: Age verification provider using facial and voice age estimation for social media, dating, gambling, and e-commerce platforms.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Truora
companies.description: Latin America-focused identity verification and background-check platform serving fintechs and marketplaces across the region.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: IDfy
companies.description: India-based identity verification and background-check platform offering employment, KYC, and document verification services.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Uqudo
companies.description: UAE-based digital identity verification company serving the Middle East and Africa (MEA), validating 156+ passport types and national IDs across 22 countries.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: iiDENTIFii
companies.description: Face-authentication and identity verification platform designed for enterprises across Africa and the Middle East.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Smile ID
companies.description: Pan-African identity verification and KYC platform supporting document and biometric checks across dozens of African countries.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Dojah
companies.description: Nigeria-based identity verification API provider offering KYC, KYB, and biometric checks across African markets.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: IdentityPass (Prembly)
companies.description: African identity verification and compliance platform (by Prembly) offering KYC, KYB, and AML screening across Nigeria and other African markets.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: VerifyMe (Africa)
companies.description: Nigeria-based identity verification platform offering KYC checks against national identity databases (BVN, NIN) across Africa. Distinct from UK's VerifyMy/VerifyMyAge.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date; name similarity to UK VerifyMy is coincidental.

companies.name: yes:id
companies.description: African digital identity verification platform validating government IDs across 150+ countries with cross-checks against Sub-Saharan and East African ID authorities.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Vove ID
companies.description: Morocco/US-based biometric KYC and AML startup providing reusable digital identity verification across Africa and the Middle East.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Biometrida
companies.description: African identity platform offering biometric verification, liveness detection, document verification, and AML/CFT controls across 248 territories.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: FaceTec
companies.description: US-based 3D face biometrics and liveness-detection technology provider used in digital ID programs including MENA government projects.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: iProov
companies.description: UK-based biometric face-verification and liveness-detection provider used by governments, banks, and healthcare organizations for high-assurance identity checks.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Binance
companies.description: Global cryptocurrency exchange requiring KYC identity verification (passports, IDs, selfies) for account tiers and regulatory compliance.
companies.notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because it directly collected and had KYC images leaked via a third-party vendor breach.

companies.name: Coinbase
companies.description: US-based cryptocurrency exchange requiring KYC verification including government IDs, selfies, and addresses for account compliance.
companies.notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because a bribed third-party support contractor exfiltrated KYC and personal data.

companies.name: France Titres (ANTS)
companies.description: French national government agency operating the database of identity documents (passports, national ID cards, driving licences) for French citizens.
companies.notes: Government identity-document authority, not a private vendor; included due to the scale of the 2026 breach affecting a third of France's adult population.

companies.name: Eurail / Interrail (Eurail Group)
companies.description: European rail-pass provider that collects passport numbers and personal data from travellers for identity verification and pass issuance.
companies.notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because it directly stored passport data that was exposed in a breach.

companies.name: UK Visa Portal (ETA-Pass)
companies.description: Third-party website (also known as UK Visit / ETA-Pass) that processed UK visa/ETA applications requiring passport and selfie uploads.
companies.notes: Not an official UK government service; a commercial third-party site processing visa applications and identity documents.

companies.name: RENAPER (Argentina)
companies.description: Argentina's National Registry of Persons, the government agency responsible for issuing national ID cards (DNI) and maintaining the national identity database.
companies.notes: Government identity authority; included due to the scale of the breach affecting nearly all Argentine citizens.

companies.name: Aadhaar (UIDAI, India)
companies.description: India's Unique Identification Authority, operator of the Aadhaar biometric national ID system used for identity verification across government and private services.
companies.notes: Government biometric ID authority; included due to multiple large-scale reported data exposures linked to the Aadhaar ecosystem.

companies.name: BankID (Sweden) / CGI
companies.description: Sweden's dominant bank-backed digital identity and authentication system (BankID), with supporting infrastructure built by IT contractor CGI.
companies.notes: Not a single company; included because a breach of contractor CGI's Swedish division exposed source code and data related to BankID authentication infrastructure.

companies.name: National ID (Bangladesh)
companies.description: Bangladesh's National Identity Registration Wing database, storing citizen identity records used for government and financial services verification.
companies.notes: Government identity database; included due to a large-scale reported public exposure of citizen NID data.

companies.name: Vouched
companies.description: US AI-powered identity verification platform specializing in healthcare (Know Your Patient), document authentication, and biometric analysis, integrated with Epic's MyChart.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Microblink
companies.description: Croatian-founded identity verification and document-capture platform, the only vendor to meet all thresholds in the US DHS RIVR evaluation as of March 2026, serving healthcare and telehealth intake.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: CLEAR (CLEAR Secure)
companies.description: US biometric identity platform best known for airport/venue expedited screening (CLEAR Plus), also offering CLEAR1 healthcare identity verification integrated with Epic.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Digidentity
companies.description: Dutch digital identity provider offering secure authentication and identity verification for healthcare, government, and enterprise sectors across Europe.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: IDENTOS
companies.description: Identity verification platform offering government-strength biometric and document verification toolsets for healthcare patient and proxy identity checks.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: VerifiNow
companies.description: US biometric identity verification vendor offering PatientVerifi, a voice/facial/liveness platform for telehealth patient authentication integrated with Zoom and Microsoft Teams.
companies.notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

companies.name: Worldcoin (Tools for Humanity)
companies.description: Biometric iris-scanning digital identity project (World ID) developed by Tools for Humanity, aiming to provide proof-of-personhood verification globally.
companies.notes: No confirmed data breach identified as of research date; included given scale of biometric data collection and ongoing regulatory scrutiny in multiple countries.

companies.name: CLEAR Plus
companies.description: CLEAR's consumer-facing biometric expedited-screening product used at US airports and stadiums, verifying identity via fingerprint and iris/facial scans.
companies.notes: Distinct entry from CLEAR's healthcare (CLEAR1) product line to reflect its separate consumer identity database; no confirmed public breach identified as of research date.
